decisions.reason: This glass-flake two-component spraying system builds directly on the firm's long-standing spraying and coating know-how, so its absorptive capacity is high and continued website presence suggests it can refine the niche offer rather than withdraw it.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the firm's core injection and construction-repair applications, and the documented field test plus dedicated product-page support indicate the firm has enough related knowledge to improve and commercialize it further.

Because this low-pressure transfer-pump line reuses proven WIWA air motors and extends an existing pump platform into several models, it is strongly supported by the firm's existing knowledge base and is unlikely to be removed soon.

Fire-protection flow monitoring is somewhat more adjacent to the firm's traditional equipment business than its pump and spraying products, but its dedicated presentation and fit with the firm's digitalized-process direction make retention more likely than withdrawal.

Although newer and therefore still less proven, the hydraulic two-component spraying system is highly related to the firm's established two-component spraying expertise, giving it strong scope to learn and improve rather than exit within a year.
